content: When the validation timeout expires for a pending wakeup event, the EcuM_MainFunction shall invoke BswM_EcuM_Current_Wakeup with an EcuM_WakeupSourceType bitmask parameter with the bit corresponding to the wakeup event set and state value parameter set to ECUM_WKSTATUS_EXPIRED.
